scope: Active MailTrace-AI repository data, model and fixture workflow; no sample message bodies are stored in this manifest.

provenance.name: MeAJOR: Merged email Assets from Joint Open-source Repositories

assets.license_status: UNRESOLVED: the reviewed Zenodo record does not declare a license in its Rights metadata; component-source terms have not been reconciled. Do not redistribute or use commercially until reviewed.
assets.privacy_status: The record describes entity-removal anonymization. Treat as derived sensitive email data until a project privacy scan and retention decision are recorded.
assets.label_schema: binary: LEGITIMATE / PHISHING; source-provided labels, not project-adjudicated threat taxonomy labels
assets.repository_state: Data files are local and Git-ignored; the sample payload is not part of the tracked repository.

assets.strategy: Three-fold leave-one-source-out; TREC-05, TREC-06, and TREC-07 each form one complete holdout group.

local_inventory.independent_review: NONE; all prepared rows are marked not_human_reviewed

source_components.name: Nazario phishing corpus 2025
source_components.license: CC BY 4.0 as recorded in the corpus README/license; attribution and modification notice required when sharing derivatives
source_components.privacy: Public phishing email content; may contain operational indicators and personal data. Keep offline; never visit embedded links.

source_components.name: CMU Enron Email Dataset, May 2015 archive
source_components.license: No corpus-wide license identified in repository records; legal review required before external/commercial reuse
source_components.privacy: Historical real corporate correspondence. CMU warns users to be sensitive to people represented in the corpus; treat as sensitive.

assets.label_quality: Source-folder proxy labels; not project-team human review. 'ham' must not be treated as adjudicated benign.
limitations: Class ratio is 2500 ham to 481 phishing (83.86% / 16.14%).
Only two broad source-derived classes; not BEC, spam, or uncertain adjudication.
Campaign-level grouping and near-duplicate audit are not recorded.

local_inventory.independent_review: NONE; all prepared rows are marked not_human_reviewed

provenance.source: Apache SpamAssassin public corpus (easy_ham and spam_2 subsets)

assets.license_status: No blanket message-content license identified. Source README says copyright remains with original senders; do not redistribute raw messages without review.
assets.privacy_status: Full headers are present in the source corpus; some addresses are obfuscated but not all. Treat as sensitive and offline-only.
assets.label_quality: Folder labels are provisional corpus labels; not project-team adjudicated. Spam is not equivalent to phishing/fraud.
limitations: Class ratio is 2500 ham to 1397 spam (64.15% / 35.85%).
The prepared subset omits hard_ham and does not represent contemporary enterprise mail.

assets.provenance: Authored synthetic samples; .invalid domains; existing manifest provides per-file SHA-256, rationale, and parser expectations.
assets.license_status: Project-authored; no third-party sample license applies.
assets.privacy_status: Existing Step 16 documentation states no personal data, credentials, live links, or attachments.
assets.use_limit: Small regression corpus only; not a representative training or detection benchmark. Parser/format labels are orthogonal metadata, not threat classes.

assets.provenance: Authored synthetic parser/normalization scenarios; .invalid domains; manifest provides per-file SHA-256.
assets.use_limit: Not a threat-detection accuracy benchmark; labels are scenarios rather than adjudicated class labels.

assets.provenance: Blinded copies of synthetic Step 16 fixtures; packet README records review as PENDING.
assets.privacy_status: Synthetic and inert per packet README; maintainer key and label-revealing files must remain restricted.

assets.status: EMPTY_TEMPLATE_ONLY; rows contain null sample fields and pending review status.
assets.use_limit: Do not report the template row count as a holdout sample count.

assets.provenance: Unknown or insufficiently documented; some names imply intent but filenames are not defensible labels.
assets.privacy_status: Unverified; possible personal identifiers or active indicators. Do not use for training, upload, or external lookup until inspected and sanitized.
assets.use_limit: Excluded from labeled corpora and model training.

assets.training_source: MeAJOR normalized binary dataset; SHA-256 is recorded in model metadata.
assets.production_status: Manifests explicitly say production_ready=false and require organization-specific validation.
assets.repository_state: Model binaries are local and Git-ignored; model manifests and metadata are present locally.
limitations: Model does not implement the requested five-class taxonomy.
Current training code uses seeded stratified random row splits; this does not prevent campaign/source leakage.
Separate source-holdout evaluations exist but are also marked not production-ready.

required_next_actions: Obtain legal approval or confirm source-level reuse terms for MeAJOR and Enron-derived content before any commercial training or redistribution.
Independently adjudicate synthetic and public-source evaluation labels; preserve reviewer provenance.
Deduplicate by message/body fingerprint and group campaign, thread, and source before creating final evaluation splits.
Keep the five-class threat taxonomy separate from parser-quality and authentication-edge labels.
